subject: Energy
title: Dyson Spheres and Megastructures
description: A short lesson to help you apply Dyson Spheres and Megastructures.

hook.text: A Dyson sphere is a megastructure enclosing a star—capturing all its energy output for an advanced civilization.

buildup.text: Physicist Freeman Dyson proposed the concept in 1960—not as a solid shell but as a swarm of orbiting collectors.

discovery.text: Our Sun radiates 3.8×10²⁶ watts—a Dyson swarm would capture energy billions of times greater than Earth's total use.

twist.text: Astronomers search for Dyson spheres around other stars—infrared waste heat signatures could reveal alien civilizations.

climax.text: Building one is beyond current technology—but it shows the theoretical upper limit of what energy harvesting could be.

punchline.text: Wrap a star in collectors—the ultimate energy fantasy.

quiz.question: Who first proposed the Dyson sphere concept?
